services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Enjoy the beautiful scenery of the Florida Keys the local way by renting one of our well equipped pontoon boats. While the majority of our renters prefer to spend their day at our beautiful sandbars in the backcountry, depending on the weather our 24’ Bently tritoon is a great choice for going snorkeling at Looe Key, diving the patch reef, or checking out American Shoal Lighthouse. Our 16 and 20 foot Suntracker pontoons are perfect for stress-free island escape out to Marvin Key. Because the waters of the backcountry are shallow and environmentally sensitive you must have boating experience and be able to carefully follow a GPS. blurb: Sugarloaf Marina is an "old school" full service marina located at MM17 in the Florida Keys. It offers boat rentals including pontoons for experienced boaters, kayak and paddleboard rentals for paddling in mangrove creeks, fishing charters with local guides, and eco tours exploring the Lower Keys backcountry. The marina has been a community hub and home to fishing guides and anglers for decades.
